detail: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process - DPSC Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process regarding investigating into the affairs of SREI Infrastructure Finance Limited and others i.e. the companies under investigation (CUls), thereby calling of information under Section 217(1) of the Companies Act, 2013.
